text: An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓen ɓe noddataa: Ko ngool woni laawol am ngol noddirta yimɓe ɓen e mun, miɗo noddira e hoore hujja ɓannguɗo, yimɓe jokkuɓe lam ɓen kadi hino noddira non, ɓen feewirɓe peewal am, ɓe jokki sunna am. Min mi jeyaaka e sirkanooɓe Alla ɓen! Ko mi jeyaa, ko e bajjinooɓe Mo ɓen Kanko Seniiɗo On njyaa mi.
